modern: Do not be ashamed to be helped; for it is your business to do your duty like a soldier in the assault on a town. What then, if you are lame and cannot climb up onto the battlements alone, but it is possible with the help of another?
original: Be not ashamed to be helped; for it is thy business to do thy duty like a soldier in the assault on a town. How then, if being lame thou canst not mount up on the battlements alone, but with the help of another it is possible?
notification: Do not be ashamed to be helped; for it is your business to do your duty like a soldier in the assault on a town.

explained.summary: There’s no shame in needing help. Marcus pictures a soldier storming a city wall: the job is to get over the battlements, and if you’re lame and need a hand to climb, you take it. Your duty is the task itself, not proving you did it alone.
explained.today: Asking a colleague to check your work, letting a friend help you move house, or admitting to your GP that you can’t manage on your own are all ways of doing the job properly, not signs of weakness.
